Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The present application relates to the field of energy storage materials, and in particular, to a lithium ion battery.

Background

Lithium ion batteries are widely used in electric vehicles and consumer electronics because of their advantages of high energy density, high output power, long cycle life, and low environmental pollution. The current demands for lithium ion batteries are: high voltage, high power, long cycle life, long storage life and excellent safety performance.

LiCoO is widely used in lithium ion batteries at present2As a positive electrode active material, LiCoO in a fully discharged state2And Li in the semi-charged state0.5CoO2Li) is relatively stable when cycled between (4.2V vs. li), so that the actual lithium ions that are actually used are only 1/2 times the actual lithium ion content. And when the voltage is more than 4.2V, LiCoO2The lithium ions with the residual 1/2 content can be continuously extracted, but during the deep lithium extraction process, Co3+Will be oxidized to very unstable Co4+And the electrolyte is oxidized together with surface oxygen losing a large amount of electrons, and a large amount of gas is generated inside the battery at the moment to cause the battery to swell. At the same time, the corrosion of HF in the electrolyte on the anode surface results in Co4+After being dissolved in the electrolyte, the electrolyte is deposited on the surface of the negative electrode, and a large amount of gas is also generated to cause battery swelling by catalyzing the reduction of the electrolyte. In addition, the 3d energy level of Co is greatly overlapped with the 2p energy level of O, deep lithium removal also causes lattice oxygen to lose a large amount of electrons, and LiCoO is caused2The unit cell is severely shrunk along the c-axis direction, local bulk phase structure instability and even collapse are induced, and LiCoO is finally caused2Active site loss and rapid capacity reduction of the lithium ion battery. Thus LiCoO2The performance is very poor when used in high voltage systems above 4.2V.

In view of this, the present application is specifically made.

Disclosure of Invention

In view of the problems in the background art, an object of the present application is to provide a lithium ion battery having excellent cycle performance and storage performance, especially excellent cycle performance and storage performance under high temperature and high voltage conditions.

In order to achieve the above object, the present application provides a lithium ion battery, which includes an electrode assembly and an electrolyte, wherein the electrode assembly includes a positive electrode plate, a negative electrode plate and a separation film. The positive active material in the positive pole piece comprises LixCoyM1-yO2-zQz，0.5≤x≤1.2，0.8≤y<Z is more than or equal to 1.0 and less than or equal to 0.1, M is selected from one or more of Al, Ti, Zr, Y and Mg, and Q is selected from one or more of F, Cl and S. The electrolyte contains an additive A, an additive B and an additive C, wherein the additive A is selected from one or more of compounds shown in a formula I-1, a formula I-2 and a formula I-3, the additive B is selected from one or more of compounds shown in a formula II-1 and a formula II-2, and the additive C is selected from one or more of compounds shown in a formula III-1.

In formula I-1, formula I-2, formula I-3: r1、R2、R3、R4Each independently selected from a hydrogen atom, a halogen atom, a substituted or unsubstituted C 1～C12Alkyl, substituted or unsubstituted C1～C12Alkoxy, substituted or unsubstituted C1～C12Amino, substituted or unsubstituted C2～C12Alkenyl, substituted or unsubstituted C2～C12Alkynyl, substituted or unsubstituted C6～C26Aryl, substituted or unsubstituted C2～C12Heterocyclic radical, in which the substituents are selected from halogen atoms, nitrile groups, C1～C6Alkyl radical, C2～C6Alkenyl radical, C1～C6One or more of alkoxy; x, y and z are independently selected from integers of 0-8; m, n and k are independently selected from integers of 0-2.

Compared with the prior art, the application at least comprises the following beneficial effects:

the application uses a lithium cobaltate material Li doped with a metal ion MxCoyM1-yO2-zQzThe doping element M of the positive electrode active material serves as a framework in the lithium cobaltate material, so that the lattice deformation of the lithium cobaltate material in the deep lithium removal process can be reduced, the degradation of the phase structure of the lithium cobaltate material is delayed, and the structural stability of the lithium ion battery when the lithium ion battery is used under the high voltage of more than 4.2V is improved.

The electrolyte solution of the present application contains a combination additive of additive a, additive B, and additive C. The additive A is a polyacrylonitrile-based six-membered nitrogen heterocyclic compound with lower oxidation potential, and a stable complex layer can be formed on the surface of the positive active material during the formation of the battery, so that the surface of the positive active material is effectively passivated, the surface activity of the positive active material is reduced, and the dissolution of transition metal into electrolyte is inhibited, thereby reducing the gas production of the battery while reducing side reactions; the additive B is a silane phosphite compound or a silane phosphate compound or a mixture of the silane phosphite compound and the silane phosphate compound, has a flame retardant effect, and can effectively improve the thermal safety of the electrolyte after being added, so that when the lithium ion battery generates thermal runaway under high-temperature storage or other extreme conditions, the additive B can reduce the risk of combustion of the lithium ion battery, and further improve the overall safety of the lithium ion battery; the additive C halogen-substituted cyclic carbonate compound can form a layer of uniform and compact protective film on the surface of a negative electrode (especially the surface of a Si-containing negative electrode), isolate the electronic conduction between the negative electrode and electrolyte, effectively reduce the side reaction between the negative electrode and the electrolyte, protect the negative electrode from being damaged, inhibit the continuous increase of the impedance of the negative electrode, and reduce the consumption of the electrolyte in the use process of a lithium ion battery; in addition, the protective film formed by the additive C on the negative electrode has excellent mechanical properties, and when the negative electrode expands and contracts in the charge and discharge processes, the protective film can keep integrity without being damaged, so that the negative electrode can be continuously and effectively protected, and the cycle performance of the lithium ion battery is improved.

The lithium ion battery has excellent cycle performance and storage performance, and particularly has excellent cycle performance and storage performance under the conditions of high temperature and high voltage.

Detailed Description

The lithium ion battery according to the present application is explained in detail below.

The lithium ion battery comprises an electrode assembly and electrolyte, wherein the electrode assembly comprises a positive pole piece, a negative pole piece and a separation film.

Wherein the positive active material in the positive pole piece comprises LixCoyM1-yO2-zQz，0.5≤x≤1.2，0.8≤y<Z is more than or equal to 1.0 and less than or equal to 0.1, M is selected from one or more of Al, Ti, Zr, Y and Mg, and Q is selected from one or more of F, Cl and S. The electrolyte contains an additive A, an additive B and an additive C, wherein the additive A is selected from one or more of compounds shown in a formula I-1, a formula I-2 and a formula I-3, the additive B is selected from one or more of compounds shown in a formula II-1 and a formula II-2, and the additive C is selected from one or more of compounds shown in a formula III-1.

The lithium ion battery has excellent cycle performance and storage performance, and particularly has excellent cycle performance and storage performance under the conditions of high temperature and high voltage. In one aspect, the present application uses a composition comprising a metal ion MDoped lithium cobaltate material LixCoyM1-yO2-zQzThe doping element M of the positive electrode active material serves as a framework in the lithium cobaltate material, so that the lattice deformation of the lithium cobaltate material in the deep lithium removal process can be reduced, the degradation of the phase structure of the lithium cobaltate material is delayed, and the structural stability of the lithium ion battery when the lithium ion battery is used under the high voltage of more than 4.2V is improved. On the other hand, the additive A, the additive B and the additive C are simultaneously added into the electrolyte, and the three additives can play a synergistic effect to jointly protect the lithium ion battery, so that the lithium ion battery has excellent cycle performance and storage performance, and particularly has excellent cycle performance and storage performance under the conditions of high temperature and high voltage.

Specifically, the method comprises the following steps:

(1) the additive A is a polyacrylonitrile-based six-membered nitrogen heterocyclic compound with low oxidation potential, nitrogen atoms in the nitrile groups contain lone pair electrons and have strong complexing effect with transition metals in the positive active material, and the additive A can be adsorbed on the surface of the positive active material to generate a loose and porous complex layer and effectively passivate the surface of the positive active material during battery formation. The complex layer can isolate the direct contact between the surface of the positive active material and electrolyte, reduce the surface activity of the positive active material, reduce a large number of side reactions on the surface of the positive active material, inhibit the transition metal from being dissolved into the electrolyte, and ensure the structural integrity of the positive active material in the use process of the lithium ion battery, thereby effectively improving the cycle capacity retention rate of the lithium ion battery under high voltage and reducing the high-temperature storage gas production rate of the lithium ion battery. In addition, the additive A has a special six-membered nitrogen heterocyclic structure, the distance between a nitrile group and a nitrile group is closer to the distance between transition metal and transition metal on the surface of the positive active material, the complexation of the nitrile group can be exerted to the maximum extent, and a greater number of nitrile groups can be exerted to the complexation, so that compared with a conventional linear nitrile group compound, the polynitrile six-membered nitrogen heterocyclic compound disclosed by the application can have a better passivation effect.

(2) The additive B is a silane phosphite ester compound or a silane phosphate ester compound or a mixture of the silane phosphite ester compound and the silane phosphate ester compound, has a flame retardant effect, and can effectively improve the thermal safety of the electrolyte after being added, so that when the lithium ion battery generates thermal runaway under high-temperature storage or other extreme conditions, the additive B can reduce the risk of combustion of the lithium ion battery, and further improve the overall safety of the lithium ion battery.

(3) The additive C is a halogen-substituted cyclic carbonate compound, and can form a layer of uniform and compact protective film on the surface of a negative electrode (especially the surface of a Si-containing negative electrode), isolate the electronic conduction between the negative electrode and electrolyte, effectively reduce the side reaction between the negative electrode and the electrolyte, protect the negative electrode from being damaged, inhibit the continuous increase of the impedance of the negative electrode, and reduce the consumption of the electrolyte in the use process of the lithium ion battery. In addition, the protective film formed by the additive C on the negative electrode has excellent mechanical properties, and when the negative electrode expands and contracts in the charge and discharge processes, the protective film can keep integrity without being damaged, so that the negative electrode can be continuously and effectively protected, and the cycle performance of the lithium ion battery is improved.
